Tabitha Sodawasser

Onboarding Specialist

Tabitha guides prospective clients from their first consultation through signing on with the firm. She makes sure our team understands what matters most to each client, and she supports the onboarding department so each day’s schedule, communications, and details stay on track. She is dedicated to giving every new client a smooth start with our firm.
